Stone Forest (Shilin) in Kunming - Complete Information

Overview
The Stone Forest, known as Shilin in Chinese, represents one of Earth's most spectacular karst landscapes. Located approximately 78 kilometers east of Kunming city center, this UNESCO World Heritage Site spans over 350 square kilometers and showcases the distinctive geological features and cultural heritage of Yunnan Province.

Geological Formation
The landscape developed over approximately 270 million years. During the Late Paleozoic Era, the region was a shallow coastal sea where "calcareous sediments and limestone were accumulated." Subsequent tectonic uplift, combined with dissolution from underground water and surface water erosion, carved the distinctive stone pillars and formations visible today. The site contains abundant marine fossils including coral, brachiopods, and trilobites.

Major Scenic Areas

Greater and Lesser Stone Forests: The core attraction featuring dense clusters of towering limestone peaks. The Greater Stone Forest offers grand vistas with sword-like formations and tower-shaped peaks. The Lesser Stone Forest presents more intricate shapes and includes the iconic Ashima Statue, symbolizing Yi ethnic culture.

Naigu Stone Forest: Located 10 kilometers away, covering approximately 10 square kilometers. "Naigu" means "ancient black" in Yi language, referring to the distinctive gray-black stone peaks. This area features "taller, older, and more majestic" formations with pristine underground karst caves.

Bushao Hill: The highest peak at approximately 1,796.7 meters elevation, offering panoramic views and displaying marine fossils dating back 270 million years.

Changhu (Long Lake) Scenic Area: Situated 26 kilometers away, this elongated lake fed by underground springs serves as the venue for ethnic Yi festivals and celebrations.

Visitor Information
Operating Hours: 8:00-18:00 (March-November); 8:00-17:30 (December-February)
Admission: CNY 130 per person; Battery car rides: CNY 25 (round trip)
Recommended Duration: 3-4 hours for core areas
Best Time to Visit: Year-round; avoid July-August for heavy rainfall; avoid Chinese public holidays due to crowds

Transportation to Stone Forest
By High-Speed Train: From Kunming South Station to Shilin West Station (approximately 20 minutes). Then take Bus No. 99 to scenic area (45-60 minutes, CNY 10) or taxi (35 minutes, approximately CNY 50).
By Bus: Direct buses from Kunming East Bus Station run frequently daily (1.5-2 hours, approximately CNY 19).

Ethnic Festivals
Torch Festival: Celebrated annually on the 24th lunar month's sixth day by Yi people. Three-day festivities include fire-lighting rituals, cultural performances, bonfires, traditional competitions (horse racing, bullfighting, archery, wrestling), singing, and dancing.
Mizhi Festival: A seven-day Sani ethnic celebration occurring in November.

sources.title: Stone Forest (Shilin): Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Stone Forest (Shilin): Travel Tips & FAQs 2026

The Stone Forest stands as one of China's most extraordinary natural wonders — a surreal landscape where towering limestone pillars rise from the earth like a petrified forest frozen in time. Located just 90 kilometers southeast of Kunming in Yunnan Province, this UNESCO World Heritage Site draws millions of visitors annually who come to witness geological formations 270 million years in the making.

Getting There: A high-speed train ride from Kunming South Station to Shilin West Station takes only about 20 minutes. Regular buses depart from Kunming's main bus station throughout the day. The journey takes about 90 minutes and costs 34 yuan one-way.

Time Required: A minimum of 3-4 hours is needed for major highlights, with 6-8 hours recommended for a comprehensive visit including Naigu area.

The main area features a 12-square-kilometer wonderland with marked paths (red route: 2 hours, blue route: 3 hours, or create custom route). The area is well-signposted in Chinese and English.

Best Time to Visit: March to May is ideal with its mild, cool weather.

sources.title: The Stone Forest in Kunming: Visitor Guide in 2026
sources.content:
The Stone Forest in Kunming: Visitor Guide in 2026

The Stone Forest (Shilin) is a UNESCO World Heritage Site located about 78 km east of Kunming. The karst landscape covers over 350 square kilometers and features towering limestone pillars formed over 270 million years.

The scenic area is divided into several zones including the Greater Stone Forest, Lesser Stone Forest, Naigu Stone Forest, Long Lake, and Bushao Hill. The Greater and Lesser Stone Forests form the core area and are the most visited.

The iconic Ashima Stone in the Lesser Stone Forest is named after the legendary Sani girl from the Yi ethnic minority's epic poem. The stone naturally resembles a young girl carrying a basket.

Tickets cost CNY 130 per person. The area is open from 8:00 to 18:00 (March-November) and 8:00 to 17:30 (December-February). Battery car rides within the scenic area cost CNY 25 round trip.

sources.title: Kunming Stone Forest - UNESCO Heritage of Karst Miracle - China Discovery
sources.content:
Kunming Stone Forest - UNESCO Heritage of Karst Miracle

The Stone Forest is one of the most famous scenic spots in Kunming and the whole of Yunnan Province. Located about 78 km southeast of Kunming, it is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its spectacular karst limestone formations.

The Stone Forest complex divides into several distinct zones, each offering unique formations and experiences. The main area features dense clusters of limestone pillars rising from the ground like a forest made of stone.

The site was designated as a national scenic area in 1982 and was included in the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2007 as part of the South China Karst. It is also a National AAAAA Tourist Attraction and a UNESCO Global Geopark.

sources.title: 昆明市石林风景区 - 百度百科
sources.content:
昆明市石林风景区 - 完整信息

基本信息
昆明市石林风景区是"云南省昆明市的国家AAAAA级旅游景区"。位于石林彝族自治县境内，距昆明78千米。保护区面积350平方千米，喀斯特地貌面积达1100多平方千米。

地理位置与地形
地理坐标介于东经103°11′至103°29′、北纬24°40′至24°56′之间。海拔1700-1950米，地势"东北高、西南低"。典型的喀斯特地貌包括石林、溶洞、湖泊、瀑布等景观。

地质特征
石林形成经历漫长演变：2.7亿年前为海洋环境，沉积石灰岩数百米厚；2.6亿年前地壳抬升成陆地；2.5亿年前火山喷发覆盖；6千万年前喜马拉雅运动使地区掀斜抬升，形成现代石林景观。

气候条件
"亚热带低纬高原山地季风气候"，冬无严寒、夏无酷暑、四季如春、干湿分明。年均温12.8-15.9℃，年降水量800-850毫米。

主要景区
- 大石林：石峰密集，最高超40米
- 小石林：疏朗秀美，阿诗玛石所在地
- 乃古石林：距大小石林北8千米，面积约10平方千米
- 长湖景区：距南25千米，湖周长5千米
- 大叠水景区：云南最大瀑布，落差92米
- 圭山国家森林公园：海拔2601米，面积3206公顷

文化特色
彝族撒尼人是主要居民，传承《阿诗玛》民族叙事长诗。重要节日包括火把节（农历六月二十四）和密枝节（农历十一月）。特色美食有汤锅、乳饼、卤腐。

旅游信息
票价：130元/人
开放时间：全年8:00-17:30
交通：高铁至石林西站、高速公路、自驾等多种方式

荣誉资质
2004年获世界地质公园称号；2007年获国家AAAAA级景区和世界遗产名录入选；2022年入选国际地科联地质遗产地名录。

sources.title: Exploring Stone Forest in Kunming: Secrets Beyond the Path
sources.content:
Exploring Stone Forest in Kunming: Secrets Beyond the Path

The Stone Forest near Kunming is a mesmerizing karst landscape that feels like stepping into another world. The towering limestone pillars, some reaching over 30 meters high, create a labyrinthine forest of stone.

Beyond the well-trodden main paths, there are quieter areas worth exploring. The Naigu Stone Forest, about 10 km from the main area, offers a more rugged and less crowded experience with darker, more dramatic rock formations.

The Yi ethnic minority's culture is deeply woven into the Stone Forest experience. The legend of Ashima, a beautiful Sani girl, is commemorated in the natural stone formation that bears her likeness. The annual Torch Festival brings the area alive with traditional celebrations.

Practical tips: Wear comfortable walking shoes as the paths can be uneven. Bring water and snacks. A battery cart is available for those who want to save energy for exploring on foot. Early morning visits avoid the largest crowds.
